post.title: Does shopping mortgage lenders hurt your credit score?
post.ig:
Five mortgage quotes can count as one hit on your credit.
FICO counts mortgage credit checks within 14 days (older versions) or 45 days (newer) as one inquiry.
One hard inquiry usually costs fewer than 5 FICO points (Experian).
Our math: 6.25% vs 6.5% on a $350,000 30-year loan = about $57 a month, $20,602 over 30 years.
Sources: myFICO, CFPB, Experian.
News and education, not financial advice.
